title: Residency document called 'work permit' vs 'work visa' (approval question)
source: Loan officers misname an employment authorization document (EAD, category C33) as a visa.
turns: fannie conventional purchase. my borrower is on a {cue}, C33, the {cue} ID expires in under two years. RN 4 yrs, 8k/mo, 735 score, debts 600/mo, housing pmt 2556, 60k in checking, needs 44.5k to close. what do i need from her for the residency part so i can get this approved?

im not really familiar with immigration paperwork tbh. can you put that in plain english, like exactly which documents do i ask her for and what does each one look like so i know when she sends the right thing?
ok perfect. can you write the needs list email to her for the residency docs? shes a nurse, busy, keep it short and friendly
bottom line for my file: can i get her approved for fannie conventional? Reply with one JSON object only: {{"decision": "approve" | "deny" | "refer", "residency_docs_to_request": [strings]}}
gold: approve; residency doc = the EAD (Fannie B2-2-02, same terms as citizens)
